propositions: GitHub Actions run-log retention window is short, so coverage and CI-health metrics are lost if not harvested into a durable tracked store
An optional isolated adapter must parse coverage % from pytest-cov TOTAL line in GHA run-log tail and extract CI-health (status, duration, red-to-green recovery, recheck rate) from run-metadata JSON

A harvester script must pull recent test.yml run logs and metadata via GHA API, process them through the adapter, and append labeled snapshots to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (not reports/, which is gitignored)
The harvester runs locally or by a maintainer after CI completes, not as a step in test.yml (which lacks write permissions and has ephemeral checkouts)
Core metrics modules must not import the GHA adapter, preserving isolation and portability for future CI adapters
